message: Hi, my little one Sia is 6 and wants to try jiu jitsu. Do you have classes for that age?

Hi! Yes, we do! We have Kids Jiu-Jitsu for ages 4-12, so Sia would be a great fit. It's a really supportive environment where kids build confidence, discipline, and learn grappling skills. Would you like to book a free trial class for her?
Yes, I’d love to book a free trial class for Sia! What time do you have available?
Perfect! I just need a few quick details to get your trial set up. What's your name?
Great, thanks Tester! Can I get your email address? That way I can send you the class confirmation.
Perfect! And what's the best phone number to reach you at?
Got it! Now I just need Sia's full name and date of birth to get her set up for the trial.
Sia's full name is Sia Sequoia, and her birthday is March 25, 2020.

Awesome! Sia is all set. Here are some available times for her free trial class:

- Saturday, July 11 at 9:00 AM
- Monday, July 13 at 5:30 PM
- Wednesday, July 15 at 5:30 PM

Which works best for you?
Let’s go with Saturday, July 11 at 9:00 AM. Thank you!

Perfect! Sia is booked for Saturday, July 11 at 9:00 AM. You'll get a confirmation email at tester.sequoia@gmail.com. Just bring Sia in comfortable workout clothes. We're at 3403 S Padre Island Dr 204. See you then!
